purpose: Incremental Research Update: a deterministic delta engine that compares a prior and current EvidenceRecord snapshot and reports NEW / UNCHANGED / REMOVED_OR_MISSING / POTENTIALLY_SUPERSEDED evidence, plus which existing ResearchArtifact references require human review. This is a delta engine only: no new research generator, no thesis writer, no valuation model, no scoring system, no BUY/SELL, no expected-return model. It answers 'what changed in the evidence set and what existing research references might need human review', never 'what should the new thesis be'. See forbidden_actions for the full list of prohibited out-of-scope operations for this task; those are constraints on the executor, not requests.
requested_actions: implement Japanese_Equity_Lab/lib/evidence/incremental_update.py providing a deterministic evidence delta (NEW/UNCHANGED/REMOVED_OR_MISSING/POTENTIALLY_SUPERSEDED) between a prior and current EvidenceRecord snapshot, using only exact identity/provenance and the existing SemanticClaim.supersedes_claim_id relationship (no text-similarity, no embeddings, no LLM matching)
map the delta onto existing ResearchArtifact.included_evidence_ids references only (read-only) to classify each artifact as UNAFFECTED or REVIEW_REQUIRED, never mutating the artifact
reuse lib.disclosures.evidence_lineage.resolve_evidence_lineage() for lineage verification of newly accepted evidence; do not duplicate its traversal logic

add unit tests in Japanese_Equity_Lab/13_tests/test_incremental_research_update.py covering the forward-update, re-extraction, multiple-filing, supersession-safety, and research-impact scenarios plus duplicate IDs, missing references, deterministic ordering, empty snapshots, lineage failure, and ResearchArtifact immutability
run ruff check and mypy --strict on incremental_update.py
run the targeted pytest suite for test_incremental_research_update.py
record any design decision in DECISIONS.md
forbidden_actions: no thesis direction decision or automatic thesis rewrite
no supersession inference from wording similarity, opposite direction, or later date alone
no model/LLM call anywhere in the delta engine
no placing this module under Japanese_Equity_Lab/lib/research/ (Phase5-reserved namespace, VAL-020 forbids importing lib.evidence there)
no edits to any frozen_files entry
